scope: Bounded DOCX native numbered-paragraph reader checkpoint
readiness: NOT_READY: reader list-termination failures, four unexecuted LibreOffice editing cases, and static-count product acceptance remain unresolved.

sourceIdentity.generationNote: Fixtures were generated from c998bca with the uncommitted numbered SourceCode continuation fix. This is dirty-tree test evidence, not a clean package build.
sourceIdentity.equivalenceScope: The recorded compiled exporter hashes still match, and the numbered-export source hash matches the committed source. This establishes identity of the audited exporter files, not an installed-package identity claim.

headlessMatrix.coverage: All nine original and headlessly resaved DOCX configurations: exact payloads, native numbered-paragraph counts, static count labels, retained StringTok runs, rendered line-number sequences and multipage code markers.
limits: Headless conversion/resaving does not establish GUI editing or reopen acceptance.
Footer attachment is an observed result for these fixtures, not a universal pagination guarantee.

effectiveHighlightAudit.algorithm: Resolve docDefaults, paragraph basedOn inheritance, character basedOn inheritance, and direct run properties; apply style bold/italic toggles; normalize hexadecimal color case; compare effective properties per code character and all token-style definitions.
limits: The general nine-case matrix contains no italic=true code characters; the separate italic probe exercises them.
Auto font/color values are compared symbolically; physical font substitution is not certified by DOCX structure.
This audit does not compare every DOCX formatting property. LibreOffice removes the SourceCode noProof and wordWrap properties during resaving.
Private audit scripts are retained locally and are not a maintained repository test command.
effectiveHighlightAudit.inputSelection: The private audit algorithm was run with the fixed fixture and fixed-headless-resave directories substituted for the earlier inputs; formatting resolution was unchanged.

italicProbe.renderInspectionMethod: Poppler pdftohtml XML identifies both comment markers as italic in color #60a0b0; pdffonts identifies an embedded oblique font before and after resaving.
limits: This probe does not establish Word rendering or GUI editing acceptance.
The reader may substitute a physical font while preserving the requested DOCX font properties.
italicProbe.renderExtraction: The Poppler XML assertions were performed separately after the private headless inspection script; they are recorded observations rather than a maintained executable test.

historicalUnnumberedFooterRecheck.reason: Recheck the earlier development-reader observation that an unnumbered 150-line code block could orphan its total.
historicalUnnumberedFooterRecheck.conclusion: The earlier orphaned-total observation did not reproduce in these five stable-reader cases. This does not rewrite the historical observation or guarantee pagination in other documents.

savedFileCheckerCoverage: reject unchanged copies presented as edits
compare exact expected paragraphs including tabs, trailing spaces and soft breaks
limits: Saved-file checks alone do not prove GUI actions; completed-case action claims come from the native desktop interaction record.
Native numbering metadata is not a substitute for reader-rendered number inspection. Passing completed cases also received visual inspection after reopening.
Existing text formatting is not automatically re-highlighted after edits.
Only the three explicitly completed LibreOffice case files are counted. Other prepared files are NOT_RUN.
